title: put_skipped
description: Event: a miss was not followed by a put. Records the fact that no store happened and why (reason); whether skipping the put is correct is for the reader to judge from the recorded reason, code and class.

reason.description: why no store happened: the response already carries an ETag (etag-present), is an error response (error-code), the entry kind is not whole-content cacheable (not-cacheable: a donut page served from its template plus inner caches is never stored as a rendered page), the response's own Cache-Control already contains no-store or private, outside what #[HttpCache]/#[NoHttpCache] declares (unstorable), or its body held a value serialize() refuses, such as a closure or a PDO connection (unserializable)

code.description: the response status code when reason is error-code; null otherwise

class.description: the class serialize() refused, when reason is unserializable; null otherwise
